id: 744-賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服納蘭霍
theater: 洪都拉斯科潘河谷納蘭霍

battle.name: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服納蘭霍
battle.theater: 洪都拉斯科潘河谷納蘭霍
battle.brief: 公元七四四年，蒂卡爾自佩滕盆地出師，長驅二百七十公里，攻入洪都拉斯科潘河谷的納蘭霍，把這座星戰古國置入蒂卡爾的宗主圈；戰爭列表把此役記在蒂卡爾王賈索·錢·卡維爾一世名下。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，未入中美洲；壓垮城垣防線的，是燧石矛頭、投槍器與黑曜石標槍。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是八世紀中葉佩滕盆地與科潘河谷之間的一場宗主權之爭，戰爭列表把七四四年記在「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服納蘭霍」的名下。進攻方是蒂卡爾王國：它坐落在佩滕盆地的雨林之中，以 K'inich 王族為核心，國王之下設攝政與戰爭首領，靠石碑與廟宇的紀功制度維持統治，並以商隊控制南部低地的貿易通道；本役的遠征軍自佩滕出發，隨行的還有向屬地與盟邦徵集的兵員與隨從。防守方是納蘭霍（Naranj Ha），即今洪都拉斯科潘河谷內 El Zapotal 一帶山脊台地上的城邦，屬伊察姆坎王統，疆域曾沿河谷伸向瓜地馬拉方向，防守依靠台地邊緣的陡坡、木柵與城內的階台式建築。背景中的第三方則是低地列強：七三八年以基里瓜背叛為開端，科潘王國崩潰，貿易中樞與人口西遷，使科潘河谷一時空虛；此時的卡拉科爾（在本站譯作卡拉克穆爾）仍與蒂卡爾爭奪低地霸權，多斯皮拉斯則在佩滕與科潘之間另立門戶。雙方的指揮系統都極簡：一面是王的命令直接下達遠征軍首領，一面是城邦君主依賴宮廷祭司與村社首領調度守軍，沒有常備職業軍團，也沒有可以統率全境的戰役指揮部。
countriesEn: This war was a struggle over overlordship between the Peten basin and the Copan valley in the middle of the eighth century, and the war list files the year 744 under the heading 'Jasaw Chan K'awiil I conquers Naranjo'. The attacking side was the kingdom of Tikal, seated in the rainforest of the Peten basin and ruled by the K'inich royal house. Tikal kept its authority alive through a commemorative system of dated stelae and temple monuments, and it controlled the trade routes of the southern lowlands with caravan traffic along the seasonal roads; for this campaign the royal expeditionary force marched out of Peten with contingents and porters levied from the vassal communities of the lowlands. The defending side was Naranjo, Naranj Ha, a city on a ridge terrace inside the Copan valley of present-day Honduras, ruled by the Itzam K'an dynasty; its territory once ran down the valley toward Guatemala, and its defence relied on the steep drop at the edge of the terrace, wooden palisades and the stepped temple platforms inside the town. The third parties lay in the background: with the revolt of Quirigua in 738 the kingdom of Copan collapsed, the trade hub and its population moved west, and the valley was briefly empty; at that moment Caracol, rendered on this site as Kalakmul, was still contesting lowland hegemony with Tikal, while Dos Pilas held its own entrance into the Peten and Copan corridor. Both command systems were elementary. On the Tikal side the king's order passed straight to the leader of the expedition, while on the Naranjo side the city ruler relied on palace priests and village headmen to call out the defenders. Neither side fielded a standing professional army, and neither had a theatre command able to direct a campaign across the whole region.
people: 戰爭列表把主角記作「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世」，即碑銘中的 Jasaw Chan K'awiil I，蒂卡爾 K'inich 王族的一世君主：他在世紀之交的蕭條之後重整王權，於六八二年立下帶有紀年的碑刻並採用 kaloomte'（眾王之主）的稱號，節制加拉斯高地的戰役節奏。他在本役的記名之下，卻是王朝的功業而非個人的在場：他在七三〇年代後期已故，與七四四年之間由攝政 Ucha'an K'in B'alam 一系主持政局，故「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服納蘭霍」宜讀作蒂卡爾王室的紀功名號。納蘭霍方面的關鍵人物是瓦克·查尼爾（Lady Six Sky），她在納蘭霍廢弛之後重建城邦，於科潘覆亡、七三八年之後向蒂卡爾求援，把河谷的存亡押在佩滕的援軍上；更早一代的納蘭霍君主卡克·蒂利烏·昌·約帕阿特（K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat）則以用兵見稱，納蘭霍二十二號石碑即記其出兵與擒獲外邦君主之事。雙方的立碑人與抄寫手亦非旁觀者：把敗績刻成「零」的一方，恰恰是靠這批石刻才留下本役的痕跡；而求援的書信與貢物，同樣經過祭司階層的手。
peopleEn: The war list names the protagonist 'Jasaw Chan K'awiil I', the ruler of the K'inich house of Tikal. He reassembled royal power after the collapse of the seventh century, raised a dated stela in 682, adopted the title kaloomte', ruler of the many kings, and set the pace of campaigning in the highlands of the Guatemalan Petexbatun. He is named here, yet what the record preserves is the achievement of a dynasty rather than his personal presence: he had died by the later 730s, and the years around 744 were run under the regency of Ucha'an K'in B'alam, so the phrase 'Jasaw Chan K'awiil I conquers Naranjo' is best read as a commemorative title of the Tikal royal house. The decisive figure on the Naranjo side was Waka' Chanil, Lady Six Sky, who rebuilt the city after its decline and, once Copan had fallen in 738, appealed to Tikal for help, staking the survival of the valley on an expedition out of Peten. An earlier Naranjo ruler, K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, was famous for his use of war, and Naranjo Stela 22 records his campaigns and the capture of foreign lords. The scribes were not bystanders either: the side that carved its own defeat into a monument as a zero is precisely the side that left this campaign any trace at all, and the appeal for help, with its tribute, likewise passed through the hands of the priestly order.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛是早王朝時期的工藝：銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣，也用它收復失地。它在七四四年並不存在於中美洲——中美洲從未有過銅器冶煉，獸骨、石英與黑曜石才是矛頭的材料，因此這件兵器從未出現在納蘭霍的城頭或蒂卡爾的陣列之中；可與它對照的，是同樣作為骨幹兵器的瑪雅長矛：燧石矛頭嵌在木杆上，握處纏皮帶以防割手，另有一類削尖的黑曜石標槍配投槍器（atlatl）拋擲，箭與矛之外還有短矛與削尖木棒。防護方面，士兵多披棉織或樹皮織的纏帶，盾是木框蒙皮的矩形盾（texcaxtli），頭戴美洲豹皮盔、鹿皮盔或棉纏頭巾，投石索以石彈或陶彈供應遠程騷擾。攻城方面沒有攻城塔、撞錘與投石機，取而代之的是放火、煙攻、水浸門板與破門而入；全軍沒有馬匹與車輛，糧食靠玉米、豆、樹薯與可可，飲水與運糧全靠徒步與獨木舟，二百七十公里的行程全靠人背肩扛。
kitsEn: The card shows an Egyptian spear of early dynastic workmanship: a copper or bronze blade bound to a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. In 744 such a weapon did not exist in Mesoamerica, because metallurgy never reached the region and bone, chert and obsidian were the materials of the point; it therefore never appeared on the walls of Naranjo or in the ranks of Tikal. The Maya counterpart of the same functional slot was the lance: a chert point set into a wooden shaft with the grip bound in hide to protect the hand, together with a class of sharpened obsidian darts thrown from an atlatl. Beyond arrows and spears there were short lances and sharpened wooden clubs. For protection, men wore banding of cotton or bark cloth, carried rectangular shields of wood or hide, texcaxtli, and wore helmets of jaguar skin, deer skin or cotton-wrapped headcloths, while slings supplied harassment with stone and ceramic missiles. There were no siege towers, battering rams or catapults; instead the besiegers used fire, smoke, water to rot the wooden gates, and storming of the breach. The army had no horses and no wagons; grain came as maize, beans, manioc and cacao, and water and freight moved on foot and by dugout canoe, the whole journey of some 270 kilometres carried on human backs.
tactics: 瑪雅人的作戰有一套固定儀式，通常稱為「星戰」：先由使節送來宣戰之辭，劃定界線，再以劫掠、毀壞神像等方式把衝突推高；開戰之日往往是旱季，長紀曆的九月（Ch'en）約當公曆十二月下旬至翌年一月中旬，正是缺水的季節，因此遠征軍取道河谷的溪流與村莊，按村徵糧，人力背運，隊伍拉成細長的縱列前進。進攻方式是先以斥候與占卜確認城內情形，再於天未亮時接戰：擲矛器手與投石索手散開成散兵線，齊射覆蓋城頭與台地邊緣，迫守軍縮回牆後；守方的反擊是密集的箭雨與擲石，以及從城階上滾落的陶球與滾木。破城靠的是耗：封住水源、燒掉城外田園與倉房、煙灌門縫，然後以斧與火破開木門，或在守軍注意力分散的缺口翻牆而入；城內爭奪集中在中央廣場與主廟的階梯，雙方以短兵相接，繃帶盾相接成線。勝負的終局不是佔領城市，而是擒獲對方君主——被擒者的名字、戰俘的形象會被刻上石碑，敗方城中的神像被拆毀，建築與碑刻被砸碎或改刻，記上「零」。本役中蒂卡爾遠征軍由佩滕直插科潘河谷，最可能採用的正是這種以斷水、焚田、破門與擒王收束的攻法。
tacticsEn: The Maya had a fixed ritual for war, usually called a star war: envoys first carried the declaration and marked out the limits of the quarrel, and the conflict was raised by raids and the smashing of god images. The campaign season was the dry season, and the ninth month of the Haab calendar, Ch'en, fell around the last days of December and the first half of January, when water was short, so expeditions marched along the streams and villages of the valleys, levied grain village by village, and stretched into a thin column with the freight on human shoulders. Assault began with scouts and divination to learn the state of the town, and the fighting was joined before dawn: atlatl throwers and slingers opened out in a loose line to sweep the terraces and the lip of the ridge, forcing the defenders back behind the walls, while the defence answered with dense arrow flights, thrown stones, and ceramic balls and rolling logs sent down the temple steps. Cities were taken by exhaustion: the water was cut off, the fields and storehouses outside the walls were burned, smoke was driven into the door seams, and then the wooden gates were opened with axe and fire, or walls were climbed where the defenders' attention had wandered. The struggle inside centred on the main plaza and the steps of the primary temple, fought at close quarters with shields locked in a line. The end of such a war was not the occupation of the city but the capture of its ruler; the name of the captive and the image of the prisoner were carved on stelae, the god images of the defeated town were torn down, buildings and monuments were smashed or recut, and the zero was set down. The Tikal expedition drove straight from Peten into the Copan valley, and the method most likely used here is exactly this: cut the water, burn the fields, break the gate, take the king.
data: 可核對的數字不多，只能列出站內既有考證所得者並標明推算。地理上，蒂卡爾核心區約十六平方公里，建築約三千座，人口估計約十二萬，另有十座蓄水庫；佩滕盆地東端佩滕克斯巴通的年雨量約二千五百毫米，蒂卡爾約一千九百四十五毫米，兩者都屬高雨量區，但旱季仍會斷流，遠征因此必須沿溪流行進。蒂卡爾至多斯皮拉斯約一百一十公里，至卡拉科爾約八十五公里，至本次的納蘭霍，按兩地坐標直線推算約二百七十公里，是本站已核各役之中最長的一次陸路行程；納蘭霍所在的科潘河谷位於瑪雅山脈東麓的科潘河與烏拉河之間，海拔較佩滕低地為高而雨量較少，屬旱季行軍最不利的地形。規模上，多斯皮拉斯王國約一千五百平方英里；卡拉克穆爾王國版圖約一萬三千平方公里，城內人口約五萬，全國約一百七十五萬，建築約六千七百五十座，主塔高約四十五米，可見佩滕與低地強國動輒以萬人計的常備與屬地兵源。里程與人口皆非本役的實測數：碑銘只記事蹟與年頭，不記人數，遠征軍的規模、傷亡與行程日數都無從確證，本卡不給出數字。月份亦然：戰爭列表的記年只到公元七四四年，未載月日，本卡所取之一月僅按瑪雅旱季出兵的通例視為約數。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, so only those already established for this project are given, with estimates marked as such. Tikal's core area covered about 16 square kilometres with some 3,000 structures and an estimated population of about 120,000, plus ten reservoirs; annual rainfall was about 2,500 millimetres at Petexbatun in the east of the Peten and about 1,945 millimetres at Tikal. Both are high-rainfall zones, yet the streams still failed in the dry season, which is why an expedition had to march along the watercourses. Tikal lay about 110 kilometres from Dos Pilas and about 85 kilometres from Caracol, and from Tikal to Naranjo the straight line between the two sites comes to roughly 270 kilometres, the longest overland march of any war yet checked here. The Copan valley lies between the Copan and Ulua rivers on the eastern foot of the Maya mountains, higher and drier than the lowland of Peten, and therefore the least favourable ground for a dry-season march. In terms of scale, the kingdom of Dos Pilas covered about 1,500 square miles; the realm of Kalakmul covered some 13,000 square kilometres, with a city population of about 50,000, a population of about 1.75 million for the whole realm, some 6,750 structures and a main temple about 45 metres high, so the lowland powers of Peten could field armies and subject populations in the tens of thousands. These distances and populations are not measured figures for this war: the stelae record deeds and years, never numbers of men, and the size of the expedition, the losses and the number of days on the march cannot be established, so no figure is offered here. The month is no better attested. The war list gives the year 744 and no month, and the January used for this card is only an approximation based on the general practice of campaigning in the Maya dry season.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因，是七三八年基里瓜對科潘的反叛。基里瓜原是卡拉克穆爾的西屬城邦，起義之後脫離卡拉克穆爾的控制並接管科潘王國，科潘城被焚，王室成員被俘，消失在玉米田與叢林之間。科潘是科潘河谷的貿易與朝貢中樞，其崩潰使河谷西段的交通線斷裂，沿河聚落的人口向西與向北流散，納蘭霍首當其衝：它位於谷地入口，本是控制上游鹽、可可與玉石通道的關口，一旦卡潘失守，納蘭霍既失去市場，也失去南面的屏障。於是納蘭霍向佩滕求援，而蒂卡爾有充分理由接下這樁交易：接納納蘭霍，等於把蒂卡爾的商路與使團保護直接延伸到烏拉河上游，順帶把卡拉科爾在低地南部的邊界推到更外側。但同樣重要的是王朝的紀功邏輯——低地王權需要「星戰」這樣的公開儀式來確認王者的正統，任何一次成功的遠征都要變成可立碑的功業，而碑上的勝負，正是下一次出師的合法性。於是救援與征服在儀式上並無分別：遠征軍帶去的既有人，也有命令。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the revolt of Quirigua against Copan in 738. Quirigua, formerly a western vassal of Caracol, threw off the overlordship of Caracol and took over the kingdom of Copan; the city was burned, the royal house was taken captive, and the dynasty disappeared into the maize fields and the forest. Copan had been the trade and tribute hub of the Copan valley, and when it fell the western stretch of the valley's road network broke apart, populations drifted west and north along the river, and Naranjo, which sat at the entrance to the valley, bore the first shock: it had controlled the outlet for salt, cacao and jade from the upper reaches, and once Copan was gone it lost both its market and its southern shield. Naranjo therefore appealed to Peten, and Tikal had every reason to accept the bargain, for taking Naranjo meant extending Tikal's caravan routes and the protection of its embassies to the headwaters of the Ulua, and at the same time pushing the frontier of Caracol further out on the southern side of the lowlands. Equally important was the dynastic logic of commemoration: lowland kingship needed a public ritual such as the star war to confirm the legitimacy of the ruler, every successful expedition had to be turned into a deed that could be carved on a stela, and the victory written on stone was itself the ground of the next march. In the ritual there was no difference between rescue and conquest: the expedition carried men and it also carried orders.
impact: 對納蘭霍而言，這場戰爭是它作為獨立城邦的最後一役。城破之後，納蘭霍的君主或攝政被擒去蒂卡爾，其廟宇、碑刻與宮殿在接下來的數十年裡繼續遭到拆毀與改刻，河谷內聚落的人口外流，重要城址如科潘與聖巴托洛梅在往後數個世紀裡再無力恢復舊日的規模，納蘭霍的建築群最終在九世紀前中期被完全廢棄，只在原址附近留下小規模再占的痕跡。對蒂卡爾而言，這是一場邊界向西南方延伸的遠征：它用一支可以離開佩滕兩百多公里的軍隊，換來對科潘河谷的間接影響，也讓王室的碑刻系統再多一件可以炫示的戰功；到了九世紀，低地南部的崩潰蔓延到佩滕盆地時，蒂卡爾自身也走向廢棄，這條向西的路線並沒有救它。對後世的考古與碑銘學而言，本役的意義在於它留下了一類事件的典型樣本：一次以擒王為終局、以毀像與刻零收束的「星戰」，在兩座相距二百七十公里的城邦之間被記錄下來，成為日後重建低地政治地圖時的一個關鍵節點。
impactEn: For Naranjo this war was the last it fought as an independent city. After the town fell, its ruler or regent was carried off to Tikal, and its temples, monuments and palaces went on being torn down and recut over the following decades; population drained out of the valley settlements, and the great sites of the valley, Copan and San Bartolome, never recovered their former scale in the centuries that followed, while the architectural group at Naranjo was finally abandoned before the middle of the ninth century, leaving only traces of small late re-occupation. For Tikal the campaign was an extension of its frontier to the south-west: it bought an indirect hold on the Copan valley with an army able to march more than two hundred kilometres away from Peten, and it gave the royal monument system one more deed to boast of; when the collapse of the southern lowlands reached the Peten basin in the ninth century, Tikal itself was abandoned, and this road to the west did not save it. For later archaeology and epigraphy the significance of the episode is that it preserves a typical sample of this kind of event: a star war closed by the capture of a king, by the smashing of images and the carving of a zero, recorded between two cities 270 kilometres apart, and now a key point for reconstructing the political map of the lowlands.
result: 結果是納蘭霍被壓服。遠征軍攻破山脊台地上的城，奪取城中的權柄與君主，拆毀其神像與紀念碑，把這座城拉入蒂卡爾的宗主圈；它此後不再以獨立的「星戰」主角出現於碑銘之中，與佩滕盆地保持了一段相對安靜的從屬關係，直到它自身在九世紀前後廢棄為止。需要說明的是，本役的直接記載極為稀少：戰爭列表只留一行「賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服納蘭霍」，年頭之外的月份、兵數與戰況都無從查證；能與之對照的，是納蘭霍與蒂卡爾兩地的碑刻系列——納蘭霍三十三號碑記其早年與卡拉科爾的星戰，二十二號碑記卡克·蒂利烏·昌·約帕阿特的用兵與擒獲外邦君主，三十二號碑留有斬首圖像，二十四號碑立於六三一年；蒂卡爾三十一號碑立於七四三年，記錄對卡拉克穆爾的戰績。可確定的是：七四四年前後，蒂卡爾方面的軍隊確曾深入科潘河谷並攻入納蘭霍，納蘭霍自此不再獨立；不能確定的是此役的規模、經過，以及那個掛在蒂卡爾王名下的征服究竟由誰執行、於哪一段日子完成。
resultEn: The result was that Naranjo was subdued. The expeditionary force broke into the city on its ridge terrace, took the authority of the town and its ruler, pulled down the god images and the monuments, and drew the city into the Tikal sphere; thereafter Naranjo no longer appears in the stelae as an independent actor in star wars, and it kept a relatively quiet dependent relation with the Peten basin until its own abandonment around the ninth century. It must be said that the direct record of this war is very thin: the war list preserves a single line, 'Jasaw Chan K'awiil I conquers Naranjo', and beyond the year there is no month, no numbers and no account of the fighting. What can be set against it are the monument series of Naranjo and Tikal: Naranjo Stela 33 records an earlier star war against Caracol, Stela 22 the campaigns of K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat and the capture of foreign lords, Stela 32 carries a decapitation image, and Stela 24 was raised in 631; Tikal Stela 31, raised in 743, records the defeat of Kalakmul. What can be established is that around 744 a force from the Tikal side did drive deep into the Copan valley and into Naranjo, and that Naranjo ceased to be independent afterwards. What cannot be established is the scale of the campaign, the course of the fighting, and who exactly carried out the conquest filed under the name of the Tikal king, and on which stretch of days.
